summary: Iteration 15 — Universal Learning Assets API + RichContentEditor + LearningAssetManager verified end-to-end. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_learning_assets.py: 17/17 PASS. All 8 /api/learning-assets/* endpoints work correctly: POST /upload (file), POST /upload-image (inline, returns {url}), POST /embed (JSON body), GET /list, GET /visible (excludes draft/scheduled/private + is_visible=false), PUT /{id} (metadata update including access_level, section, embed_url), DELETE /{id} (also deletes file from disk), GET /topic/{id} (visible only). Auth guarded correctly (upload/embed/update/delete return 401 for anon). Inline uploaded image is actually served over /api/uploads/assets/images/{fname} (verified with GET returning image content-type). Media library mirror row is created for both upload endpoints (folder=inline-images for images, folder=assets/{type} for regular). Frontend: admin@edvnova.com login → /admin renders 13 tabs [Overview, Website Content, Chapter Notes, Topics, Worksheets, Questions, Videos, Media Library, Courses, Products, Users, Orders, Contacts] — NO 'Resources' tab. Chapter Notes tab shows ChapterNotesEditor with board/subject/chapter selectors; selecting IGCSE→Physics→Electricity lists 5 topics. Clicking a topic row expands it and reveals: Introduction (text+images) w/ RichContentEditor, Content Sections, Definitions, Formulas (w/ inline formula rows), Worked Examples, Learning Assets — with 4 LearningAssetManager instances (introduction, formulas, worked-examples, general) plus one per dynamic content section (asset-mgr-{topicId}-{section} testids). Existing pages regression: /, /about, /contact, /store, /learn, /learn/igcse/physics/electricity all render correctly with expected content. Both prior-iter14 bugs are fixed and verified: /api/membership/my-tier now queries DB directly; /api/attachments/upload persists access_level from Form param.

minor.issue: No whitelist on asset_type or extension — accepts arbitrary values. Same defense-in-depth note carried from iter 12/13.
No URL scheme/domain validation for embed_url. Could accept javascript: or file:// URLs. Recommend allowlist (YouTube, Vimeo, https-only).
content_type is trusted from client; no image sniff to confirm actual image bytes. Could accept a .png named text file.

issues: Row header uses cursor-pointer on the container div AND places the publish checkbox + status pill inside; a click on the outer row expands, click on the checkbox publishes (with stopPropagation) — works correctly, but the whole row responds to a click which can be confusing. Consider a dedicated chevron/expand affordance for clarity.

React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Some option contains a <span> — likely the topic count badge. Cosmetic hydration warning only; dropdown works. Locate & fix inside ChapterNotesEditor.js chapter <option> rendering.
Benign 401s on /api/auth/me for anonymous visitors (carried from prior iterations).

action_items: (Optional/hardening) Validate embed_url against allowlist (https + YouTube/Vimeo host) in learning_assets_api.add_embed_asset.
(Optional/hardening) Sniff image magic bytes in /upload-image; reject non-image content and enforce an ext allowlist.
(Cosmetic) Fix hydration warning in ChapterNotesEditor.js chapter <select> — one of the <option> children contains a <span>; wrap the label in plain text or use a data attribute for the count.
(Optional/UX) Add an explicit expand chevron button on chapter topic rows so accidental double-clicks / checkbox misfires are avoided.
critical_code_review_comments: learning_assets_api.upload_asset: file.filename is used to derive extension via rsplit — safe, but the doc stores original_name and content_type verbatim from client. Consider stripping path separators from filename and rejecting empty filename.

learning_assets_api.delete_asset: attempts to unlink from both /app/uploads/assets/{fname} and /app/uploads/assets/images/{fname}. Works, but a cleaner approach is to reconstruct the path from the stored file_url (already prefixed correctly). Current code is functional and idempotent.

learning_assets_api uses ObjectId.is_valid(asset_id) — good. But list/visible/topic endpoints do not sanitize parent_id (a large or malicious string could scan indexes). Add length cap (e.g. len < 200).

RichContentEditor.js stores blocks in-memory only; blocksToText() (in ChapterNotesEditor) converts to plaintext for saving to content.introduction/sections — that means IMAGE BLOCKS ARE LOST on save if introBlocks contain image blocks (blocksToText likely joins only 'text' block values). Verify with a mixed-block save round-trip — this could be a latent data-loss bug for admins who mix images into rich content and hit Save. Recommend storing raw block array in a new field or serializing images inline as markdown/HTML.

LearningAssetManager.js: on file-only upload dialog, the Choose-file button uploads the moment a file is selected — there is no cancel or preview step; combined with the fact that the dialog does not close on error, admins may not realise a failed upload. Toast handles it, but flow could be tighter.
learning_assets_api.upload_asset: `count = db.learning_assets.count_documents(...)` sets order = count. Concurrent uploads to the same parent/section will race and produce duplicate order values.
learning_assets_api.reorder_assets: no auth on individual _id ownership check — any admin can reorder any parent's assets, which is fine, but there is no bounds validation (e.g. list of 10000 ids).

server.py: /api/uploads is served via StaticFiles with no auth wrapper. Any asset uploaded with access_level='private' is still directly downloadable by anyone who knows the URL. The access_level is only enforced at the metadata /list endpoint. This is a data-exposure bug: /visible + /topic hide private items but the file URL is still public. Consider a signed URL scheme or per-file auth middleware for /api/uploads/assets/*.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: login, 13 tabs, chapter notes editor, topic expand, RichContentEditor + LearningAssetManager render)

seed_data_creation: Test module creates + cleans up 4 learning assets (upload+embed+draft+delete-throwaway) under a random TEST_iter15_{hex} parent_id — all deleted in module teardown. Two mirrored media_files rows are left in DB (inline-images folder + assets/pdf folder) — not cleaned but tagged TEST_iter15 filenames.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 (Universal Learning Assets) fully verified. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_learning_assets.py. Key open concern for main agent: (1) potential data-loss bug in RichContentEditor→blocksToText save round-trip — image blocks may be stripped when persisted to topic.content.introduction/sections (plain-text field); worth confirming end-to-end round-trip retains images. (2) StaticFiles serves /api/uploads/* unauthenticated — private access_level assets are still URL-downloadable. Non-blocking for MVP but worth logging.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failing tests this iteration. Two hardening notes filed in critical_code_review_comments (RichContentEditor persistence + /api/uploads private access).
